text: 瑞银证券中国股票策略分析师孟磊表示，近期全球资本市场出现剧烈波动，在科技板块的交易拥挤有所释放后，科技板块和AI仍是下半年的市场主线。科技板块受益于全球人工智能的快速发展以及国内政策的大力支持有望维持强劲的盈利增长。包括行业主题ETF、科技赛道型主动公募、融资、私募等各类资金有望持续净流入科技板块。
text_en: UBS Securities China equity strategy analyst Meng Lei said recent sharp volatility in global capital markets, after a relief in technology sector crowding, technology and AI remain the market's main themes for the second half of the year. The technology sector, benefiting from rapid global AI development and strong domestic policy support, is expected to maintain robust earnings growth. Various funds, including sector-themed ETFs, technology-focused active public funds, margin financing, and private funds, are expected to continue net inflows into the technology sector.
